title: Training Notes: Wayfare Pro Forgiveness of Recounted Cancellation-Rate Warnings
content:
These notes set out a rule of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product for drivers with a high Wayfare Pro status. The status is the Pro status held on the driver's earnings account under the **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** product.

**Rule.** A driver whose earnings account holds Wayfare Pro Platinum, Wayfare Pro Diamond or Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite has 3 recounted warnings of the cancellation warning sequence number forgiven; a driver holding Wayfare Pro Gold has 2 forgiven; a driver holding Wayfare Pro Blue or Silver has none forgiven. Forgiveness is taken off the recounted warnings but never below zero.

| Pro status on the earnings account | Recounted warnings forgiven |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 3 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 3 |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 3 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 2 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 0 |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | 0 |

### Questions answered

**What are "recounted warnings"?** The earlier cancellation-rate warnings counted when the cancellation warning sequence number of a new cancellation-rate warning is recounted. Forgiveness acts on that count only.

**Can forgiveness take the count below zero?** No. If a Diamond driver's recount finds 2 earlier warnings, 3 are forgiven and the count becomes zero, not less.

**Hypothetical examples.** A recount finds 4 earlier cancellation-rate warnings. For a Gold driver the count after forgiveness is 2; for a Platinum driver it is 1; for a Silver driver it stays 4.
